description_en: Moves a task flow to a specified business scenario
description_zh: 调用MoveTaskFlowToScenario接口，移动任务流至指定业务场景
name: MoveTaskFlowToScenario

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The task flow ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination business scenario. If this parameter is left empty or set to a value less than or equal to 0, the task flow is moved to the default business scenario
parameters.help_zh: 目标业务场景ID。参数缺省或小于等于0时移动至默认业务场景
parameters.name: scenario_id

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
